guide.title: How to work this list
guide.html:
• 🟢 L1 problems first, top to bottom — skip the rest on the first pass. Within a pattern, easy → medium. Read the pattern note's Mental Trigger before the first problem of each pattern — the pattern is what you're drilling, not the problem.

  • Say the pattern and the complexity out loud before coding. Stuck > 35 minutes: re-read the note's Mental Trigger, look at the solution, log the stalled line, and re-attempt it cold at the end of the family.

  • One family per sitting — don't mix Trees and DP in one session.

  • Language: Python. Java only for a Java-specific loop — port 10 already-solved patterns, don't re-solve.

  • Cadence: 3 sittings a week, ~100 min, 3–4 problems.

  • Exit criterion for the L1 pass: a random unseen medium solved cold in 25 min, with optimal complexity stated before coding. Pass → start the second pass at 2 sittings a week. Fail → one week of cold re-solves from the night log, then retest.

  • Second pass = every unticked problem, same order and rules. Re-solve any L1 problem logged N in the night log first.

guide.title: AI-loop practical round
guide.html:
Many AI/ML-engineer loops swap one DSA round for implement-from-scratch (NumPy only), data wrangling, or debugging. Same drill: recognise the shape, code it clean, state the complexity.

  • k-means — init, assign, update, converge; vectorised distance matrix (most asked)
  • Logistic regression + batch gradient descent — derive the gradient, stable sigmoid
  • k-NN, fully vectorised — broadcasting; argpartition = quickselect (P14)
  • Softmax + cross-entropy, numerically stable — subtract the max
  • Scaled dot-product attention — single head; stretch: multi-head + causal mask
  • Top-k / top-p sampling — heap vs sort vs partition (P14)
  • BPE tokenizer merge loop on a toy corpus — counter fluency, greedy pair merging
  • 2-layer MLP forward + backward — chain rule, shape discipline
  • Batched cosine similarity / embedding search — normalise, matmul, top-k: the RAG kernel
  • Data wrangling — groupby / aggregate / join on messy data; rolling-window stats (P03 / P04)
  • Debug a training loop — missing zero_grad(), LR too high, softmax before CrossEntropyLoss, eval-mode leakage
  • Rate limiter (token bucket / sliding-window log) — everyone asks this one
